_about: Public-domain James Morison (1816-1893), founder of the Evangelical Union in Scotland, for the Word Hoard: A Critical Exposition of the Third Chapter of Romans (1866), Commentary on the Gospel according to Matthew (1870), Mark's Memoirs of Jesus Christ (1873) and The Extent of the Atonement (1882), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
